triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p2 → p3 by the maintainer's grading principle of 2026-11-18**, accepted in triage's session (「刚才你建议的分级调整，我全部接受」).

The principle, in order:
1. What a new user or a prospect meets first (looks and the main flow), the cloud core (Turso, hosted sign-up and onboarding, hosted install and upgrade, plans) and a developer's first contact come first.
2. Data loss or a permission breach in normal use stays first.
3. Details and rare configurations are improved over time.
4. Internal items are frozen.

Why this card: internal: lint test performance with no user effect (frozen).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Closing as not planned · 2026-11-19T06:26Z (seat 1, `area:build` W0; independent fable review in the seat's project, summary shown to the maintainer in this account's fleet project before this close; the maintainer may reopen).
- The asked fix (memoize the ledger reads inside `runAuthoringRules`) contradicts the invariant at `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts:419-422`: "Deliberately NOT memoized … a cached verdict outlives the ledger edit".
- Its trigger #34834 closed completed (the fix #35024 split the test case instead of caching). A real `os build` calls the reader once, so there is no user-visible cost.
- Triage regraded it to p3 under the maintainer's 2026-11-18 grading principle (internal items frozen), comment 6969882151.
